A weapon is an item equippable in the melee or ranged slot used to deal damage to mobs in Minecraft Dungeons.

Obtaining

Weapons can be obtained by opening chests, defeating mobs, exchanging emeralds with merchants in Camp, and from gifting via the gift wrapper. There are 83 obtainable melee weapons in total, including 56 uniques, seven of which are seasonal event-exclusive. There is one unused melee weapon. There are 72 ranged weapons in total, including 48 uniques, seven of which are seasonal event-exclusive. There is one unused ranged weapon.

Power level

A weapon's power level affects its stats, with a higher power level weapon having higher damage output than a lower power one of the same type. The power level of a weapon can be increased at the blacksmith at the cost of emeralds and the completion of three missions or secret missions. The maximum power level for weapons received from merchants, ordinary missions, and blacksmith upgrading is 251 for rare and unique rarity items and 250 for common rarity items. The maximum power level for weapons received through daily trial and raid captain reward chests is 256. Raid captain reward chests can surpass the 256 limit and reach a maximum of 263 by collecting all six raid banners in a tier three daily trial. Weapons obtained by completing The Tower also reach a maximum power of 263.

Enchanting

Main article: MCD:Enchanting

Both melee and ranged weapons can be enchanted from the inventory. Weapons can have up to three enchantment sections which contain up to three enchantment slots. An enchantment can be chosen within each enchantment section to provide its properties, and can be further upgraded to a second and third level. Enchantment slots can be rerolled using the enchantsmith by exchanging gold. Weapons are unenchanted when upgraded using the blacksmith or modified using the enchantsmith. Unique weapons often feature built-in tier one enchantments, and gilded weapons feature another built-in enchantment that can reach up to tier three. Gilded weapons can be obtained within Ancient Hunt and from the piglin merchant.

Melee weapons

"Melee Weapon" redirects here. For melee weapons in Minecraft, see Weapon § Melee weapons.

Melee weapons are weapons that can be used to damage nearby entities.

Close range combat is the hero's unlimited and reliable source of damage output with no ammo requirement. However, the immediate proximity to mobs positions the hero within melee mobs' attack ranges, risking loss of health and receiving negative status effects such as becoming Frozen. Ranged mobs also take advantage of the time taken for the melee hero to approach them.

Long ranged melee weapons such as glaives can help keep a distance between the hero and mobs or received damage can be mitigated and nullified by consistent healing with Radiance on high speed weapons such as the fighter's bindings.

If no melee weapons are equipped, the hero's fists are used to inflict 1 damage point to mobs.

Combos

Combo length is the number of different attack movements in a Melee weapon's attack sequence.

The final attack of a combo triggers Shockwave and Swirling enchantments and inflict the maximum damage specified for the weapon in the inventory.

Ranged weapons

Ranged weapons are weapons that can be used to damage entities from a distance away.

At the cost of 1 arrow per use and becoming stationary during aiming, ranged weaponry is the player's finite solution of outputting damage while distancing themselves from mob onslaught, unless of course the player decides to utilize it at close range. Attacking at distance does not go unnoticed; mobs nearby to the damaged mob are alerted and begin to target the ranged player.

If no ranged weapons are equipped, the game notifies the player through a sound cue upon pressing the Ranged Attack Button.

Ammo

The ammo number represents the number of arrows the player possess and is shown in the quiver slot of the Heads-up Display. When ammo number reaches zero, ranged weaponry cannot be used. Arrow stocks can be restored by collecting arrow bundles that drop from chests, mobs, Surprise Gift, and Recycler. Infinity provides a chance for arrows to not be consumed upon use while Multishot, Chain Reaction, and Bonus Shot can project more arrows per arrow fired - especially formidable on ranged weapons that already fire multiple projectiles such as the winter's touch and harp crossbow.

Arrows that hit a wall disappear within 10 seconds.

Collected TNT resides in the quiver slot up to a maximum of 3 and prevents the use of ranged weaponry until the TNT has been thrown.

Similarly, a conduit, when collected, is stored in the quiver slot and prevents ranged weapon usage until thrown.

Using a fireworks arrow, flaming quiver, torment quiver, thundering quiver, harpoon quiver, or void quiver artifact places special ammo in the quiver slot consumed before regular arrows. Using dipping poison arrows will also place special ammo in the quiver slot.

Submerged projectiles

This section describes content that is a part of the Hidden Depths DLC.

Arrows fired when submerged in Hidden Depths missions are greatly slowed and decelerate rapidly making them unviable for underwater combat.[2] This disadvantage can be avoided by using the harpoon crossbow or nautical crossbow, or by activating the harpoon quiver to gain harpoon ammo.

Bows

Bows are ranged weapons that can fire a charged shot when the ranged attack button is held and released. Charged shots deal more damage to mobs than un- or partially-charged Shots. As such, enchantments relating to charging cannot be applied to crossbows.

There are thirty-nine bows in total, including twenty-seven uniques, five of which are seasonal event exclusive.

Crossbows

Crossbows are ranged weapons that fire continuously when holding the ranged attack button. Unlike bows, crossbows do not fire charged shots; however, they do fire quickly. The lack of charge shots prevents them from obtaining enchantments involving charging.

There is a total of thirty-one crossbows, including nineteen uniques, one of which is seasonal event exclusive.

History

Minecraft Dungeons
Dungeons Beta Added weapons.
Beta_Update_April_3 Changed so that attacking mobs from a distance now alerts nearby unaware mobs.
Changed mace 3rd attack damage 90 -> 140, area 225 -> 250. Katana speed ≈ +30%. Daggers range 330 -> 350. Rapier damage 11 -> 13, last attack damage 60 -> 70. Soul scythe damage 75 -> 80, splash factor 0.75 -> 0.85. Hunting bow ammo +50%, charged shot damage multiplier 2.5 -> 2.0. Power bow damage +33%. Trickbow damage +20%, projectile speed +20%. Wind bow ammo +20%.
